text: Two concerns pull in opposite directions: completing alias removal and acting without evidence about every known client. The first concern is valid, but the evidence supports a narrower conclusion. 1) The migration renamed three public fields while retaining compatibility aliases. 2) Twelve of fourteen known clients have migrated; the status of two remains unknown. 3) Integration tests cover the twelve migrated clients, not the other two—a nearly complete map still has blank corners. I therefore recommend a bounded rejection: do not remove the aliases until both remaining client owners confirm migration. In short: evidence for twelve, uncertainty for two; retain now, remove after confirmation.
